name: Aston Villa
headline: Who would you rather watch the match with?
subline: Pick your matchday companion. The Villans decide the ranking.

cards.name: Paul McGrath
cards.tagline: The fans call him God, and he stays calm like one.

cards.name: John McGinn
cards.tagline: Never stops running, never stops talking, never stops celebrating.

cards.name: Jack Grealish
cards.tagline: Boyhood fan, so he knows the chants and the pub.

cards.name: Gordon Cowans
cards.tagline: Calm, wise, and always sees the pass.

cards.name: Dwight Yorke
cards.tagline: Smiles at everything, including a 0-0.

cards.name: Peter Withe
cards.tagline: Tells the story of the 1982 winner every time.

cards.name: Stiliyan Petrov
cards.tagline: Humble, brave, and the most popular man in the stand.

cards.name: Dennis Mortimer
cards.tagline: Led the team to Europe and still leads the room.

cards.name: Ian Taylor
cards.tagline: Lived the dream and is happy to retell it.

cards.name: Emiliano Martinez
cards.tagline: Fiery, loud, and ready to wind up the opposition.

cards.name: Unai Emery
cards.tagline: Talks about the next match during this one.

cards.name: Ron Saunders
cards.tagline: Hard, serious, and quietly proud of the 1981 title.

cards.name: Tony Barton
cards.tagline: Steps up quietly and wins the biggest prize.

cards.name: Brian Little
cards.tagline: Won the League Cup as a player and a manager, and tells you twice.

cards.name: Dean Smith
cards.tagline: Boyhood fan who knows every chant.

cards.name: George Ramsay
cards.tagline: Won six titles and six cups, so he is hard to argue with.

cards.name: Graham Taylor
cards.tagline: Shouts instructions from the stand, whether or not you asked.

cards.name: Ron Atkinson
cards.tagline: Talks loud, dresses louder, and enjoys himself most.

cards.name: Martin O'Neill
cards.tagline: Intense, driven, and winding up the whole row.

cards.name: John Gregory
cards.tagline: Confident, chatty, and sure the title is next.

cards.name: Prince William
cards.tagline: Knows the fans, the chants, and the stands from his school days.

cards.name: Tom Hanks
cards.tagline: Picked the club because it sounded like a lovely holiday, and stayed.

cards.name: Ozzy Osbourne
cards.tagline: Loudest voice in the stand and the loudest laugh.

cards.name: David Bradley
cards.tagline: Celebrates on the pitch if you let him.

cards.name: Nigel Kennedy
cards.tagline: Wild, eccentric, and fully committed to the cause.

cards.name: Lee Child
cards.tagline: Names the characters after the players and quietly takes notes.

cards.name: Brendan Gleeson
cards.tagline: Quiet, wry, and a very good storyteller.

cards.name: Ian Bell
cards.tagline: Quiet, studious, and keeps a score of everything.

cards.name: Mark Williams
cards.tagline: Warm, funny, and cheers every goal like a family dinner.

cards.name: Greg Davies
cards.tagline: Towering, sarcastic, and blocks the view in the best way.
